description: This file defines a health check flow for a PostgreSQL database within a .NET project. It includes data representations for requests and results, and a static method to perform the connectivity check asynchronously, utilizing dependency injection for configuration and logging.

classes.name: DatabaseHealthCheckRequest
classes.description: Request object for initiating a database health check, currently empty.

classes.name: DatabaseHealthCheckResult
classes.description: Result object indicating whether the database is configured and healthy, and including error details if any.

classes.name: DatabaseHealthCheckFlow
classes.description: Contains a static method to perform an asynchronous health check of the Postgres database connectivity.

methods.name: RunAsync
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous health check on the database by attempting a connection and simple query, returning a result object with status.
